en.landing.heroBody: Ask with an AI conversation assistant. Read menus and documents with a scan. Translate, reply and learn in one App.
en.landing.heroNote: Free to download. Pro is available in the App.
en.landing.featureTitle: See what you can do with it.
en.landing.featureBody: From the first question to the next reply, find the tool for the moment. Every feature is right here.
en.landing.agentTitle: Not sure how to ask? Get help asking.
en.landing.agentBody: Tell the assistant your goal. It helps you ask follow-up questions and check the details, while you make the decisions.
en.landing.menuTitle: Understand the menu. Order what you want.
en.landing.menuBody: Read dishes and prices, choose quantities and options, then show your order in the staff’s language.
en.landing.documentTitle: Find the details without the wall of text.
en.landing.documentBody: Scan a paper document into clear paragraphs and tables. Compare the translation to find times, prices and key information.
en.landing.keyboardTitle: Reply in the App you already use.
en.landing.keyboardBody: Translate your message and adjust the tone from your iPhone or iPad keyboard. Spend less time copying between Apps.
en.landing.voiceBody: Use bilingual captions and spoken translations at check-in, while asking directions or in an everyday conversation.
en.landing.textTitle: Say it naturally, with the right tone.
en.landing.textBody: Translate messages and emails, choose the tone, then listen or copy your reply. Go from understanding to answering.
en.landing.chatTitle: Still have a question? Ask the next one.
en.landing.chatBody: Bring text or a photo into Chat. Clarify a phrase, ask for an example or work out how to reply.
en.landing.helperTitle: Understand the meaning. Learn the usage.
en.landing.helperBody: Explore grammar, vocabulary, examples and cultural context beside your translation, with explanations shaped around you.
en.landing.widgetBody: Bring language practice to your Home Screen. Review words and phrases in spare moments and hear their pronunciation in the App.
en.landing.photosBody: Translate a sign, label or notice from your camera or photo library, without typing it out.
en.landing.knowledgeBody: Save your learning goals or preferred explanation style. Reuse them with Helper; Pro supports up to five profiles.
en.landing.historyTitle: Find it again when you need it.
en.landing.historyBody: Return to translations, organized scans and conversation records. Keep useful details within reach.
en.landing.proTitle: More room for your everyday language needs.
en.landing.proBody: For work messages, longer conversations and learning that fits your day. Choose Pro when you need more.
en.landing.proTextBody: Unlimited text, photo and Chat translation counts with Pro.
en.landing.proVoiceBody: More voice translation minutes for questions, replies and the details that follow.
en.landing.proKnowledgeBody: Save up to five custom knowledge profiles for explanations that fit work, study and daily life.
en.landing.proWidgetBody: Customize learning Widget content, topics and difficulty with Pro.
en.landing.proNote: Start free. Pro prices, usage allowances and renewal terms appear in the App before purchase.
en.landing.proCta: Download free. Explore Pro in the App.
en.landing.faqTitle: A few things you may want to know.
en.landing.faqFreeQ: Can I try it for free?
en.landing.faqFreeA: Yes. Download the App for free and try the basic features. Pro is optional; prices, allowances and renewal terms are shown before purchase.
en.landing.faqPlatformsQ: Can I use it on Mac too?
en.landing.faqPlatformsA: AnyTranslator is available on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Some tools depend on the platform: the translation keyboard is for iPhone and iPad.
en.landing.faqAgentQ: How is the conversation assistant different from voice translation?
en.landing.faqAgentA: Voice translation helps both people understand what is said. The AI conversation assistant works from your goal to help ask questions, clarify and review details. You remain in control.
en.landing.faqKeyboardQ: How do I translate in a messaging App?
en.landing.faqKeyboardA: Enable the AnyTranslator keyboard and Full Access in iOS settings, then switch to it in a supported text field. Some secure fields and Apps restrict third-party keyboards.
en.landing.faqScanQ: What happens after I scan a menu or document?
en.landing.faqScanA: Menus become translated dishes and prices with an order you can show to staff. Documents become readable paragraphs and tables. You can reopen saved scans from history.
en.landing.faqAccuracyQ: How can I get a better translation?
en.landing.faqAccuracyA: Give the text enough context, choose the appropriate tone and use a clear photo for scans. For important names, amounts and decisions, compare the original and translation.
en.landing.ctaTitle: Your next message. Your next trip.
en.landing.ctaBody: Try one real task: scan a menu, translate a reply or ask the assistant to help you speak.
en.landing.seoTitle: AI Translator, Voice Assistant & Menu Scanner
en.landing.seoDescription: Translate text and live conversations, scan menus and documents, reply with a translation keyboard and learn with Widgets. Free download for iPhone, iPad and Mac.

zh-tw.landing.eyebrow: 讓外語生活更順手的 AI 助手
zh-tw.landing.heroBody: AI 對話助手幫你問清楚，菜單文件一掃就懂。即時翻譯、訊息回覆與日常學習，一個 App 搞定。
zh-tw.landing.heroNote: 免費下載，Pro 方案可於 App 內選購。
zh-tw.landing.featureTitle: 每個語言關卡，都有順手的工具。
zh-tw.landing.featureBody: 從開口問，到看懂、回覆與複習。所有功能都在這裡，找到你現在用得上的那一個。
zh-tw.landing.agentTitle: 不知道怎麼問，AI 幫你問清楚。
zh-tw.landing.agentBody: 告訴助手你的目標，協助開口、追問與核對細節。對話看得懂，決定由你做。
zh-tw.landing.menuBody: 翻譯菜名與價格，選好數量和加選項目，再把點餐清單用店員的語言出示。
zh-tw.landing.documentTitle: 段落表格整理好，重點更好找。
zh-tw.landing.documentBody: 拍下紙本文件，整理成清楚的段落與表格。對照原文與翻譯，快速查找時間、價格與重要資訊。
zh-tw.landing.keyboardTitle: 留在原本的 App，把回覆說清楚。
zh-tw.landing.keyboardBody: 在 iPhone 或 iPad 鍵盤直接翻譯訊息、調整語氣，少一點來回複製與切換。
zh-tw.landing.voiceTitle: 聽懂對方，也讓對方聽懂你。
zh-tw.landing.voiceBody: 飯店入住、問路或日常聊天，用雙語字幕與譯文朗讀，把一來一往的對話接下去。
zh-tw.landing.textBody: 翻譯訊息與 Email，選擇合適語氣。聽發音、複製回覆，從看懂接著聊下去。
zh-tw.landing.chatBody: 帶著文字或照片進入對話，釐清一句話、找個例句，或一起想好怎麼回覆。
zh-tw.landing.helperTitle: 看懂意思，也知道怎麼用。
zh-tw.landing.helperBody: 在譯文旁看文法、單字、例句與文化背景，讓解說配合你的學習方式。
zh-tw.landing.widgetBody: 把外語練習放上主畫面，零碎時間複習詞句，再到 App 裡聽發音。
zh-tw.landing.everydayTitle: 翻譯之後，還能繼續用得上。
zh-tw.landing.photosBody: 拍照或從相簿選圖，看懂路標、商品標籤與公告，省去手動輸入。
zh-tw.landing.knowledgeBody: 儲存學習目標或喜歡的解說方式，之後交給 Helper 沿用。Pro 最多支援 5 組設定。
zh-tw.landing.historyTitle: 需要的時候，隨時找回來。
zh-tw.landing.historyBody: 重新開啟翻譯、已整理的掃描與對話紀錄，重要資訊不必重新找。
zh-tw.landing.proTitle: 每天都用得到，Pro 更順手。
zh-tw.landing.proBody: 工作訊息、完整對話與日常學習，留給你更多使用空間。需要更多時，再選擇 Pro。
zh-tw.landing.proTextBody: Pro 文字、照片與 Chat 翻譯不限次數。
zh-tw.landing.proVoiceBody: 更多語音翻譯分鐘，從開口問到核對細節，都有空間接下去。
zh-tw.landing.proKnowledgeTitle: 偏好存一次，之後接著用。
zh-tw.landing.proKnowledgeBody: 最多 5 組自訂知識，讓工作、學習與日常解說各有適合的設定。
zh-tw.landing.proWidgetBody: Pro 可自訂學習 Widget 的內容、主題與難度。
zh-tw.landing.proNote: 免費開始體驗。Pro 價格、使用額度與續訂條款，會在 App 購買前顯示。
zh-tw.landing.proCta: 免費下載，在 App 內探索 Pro。
zh-tw.landing.faqFreeA: 可以。免費下載 App 並體驗基本功能，Pro 可自行選購；價格、使用額度與續訂條款會在購買前顯示。
zh-tw.landing.faqPlatformsA: AnyTranslator 支援 iPhone、iPad 與 Mac。部分工具依平台提供，例如翻譯鍵盤適用於 iPhone 與 iPad。
zh-tw.landing.faqAgentQ: 對話助手和語音翻譯有什麼不同？
zh-tw.landing.faqAgentA: 語音翻譯幫雙方聽懂彼此說的話；AI 對話助手依你的目標，協助開口、追問與整理重點，最後由你審閱並決定。
zh-tw.landing.faqKeyboardQ: 怎麼在聊天 App 裡翻譯？
zh-tw.landing.faqKeyboardA: 在 iOS 設定啟用 AnyTranslator 鍵盤與完整取用，再於支援的輸入欄切換使用。部分安全輸入欄及 App 會限制第三方鍵盤。
zh-tw.landing.faqScanQ: 掃描菜單或文件後，可以做什麼？
zh-tw.landing.faqScanA: 菜單會整理成翻譯菜色與價格，選好餐點就能向店員出示清單；文件會整理成可讀的段落與表格。已儲存的掃描可從歷史紀錄重新開啟。
zh-tw.landing.faqAccuracyA: 文字提供完整語境、選擇適合語氣，掃描時拍清楚。重要的人名、金額與決定，可搭配原文對照確認。
zh-tw.landing.ctaTitle: 下一封訊息、下一趟旅行，
zh-tw.landing.ctaBody: 先完成一件小事：掃一張菜單、翻一則回覆，或讓助手陪你開口。
zh-tw.landing.seoTitle: AI 翻譯、對話助手與菜單掃描
zh-tw.landing.seoDescription: 文字與即時語音翻譯、AI 對話助手、菜單文件掃描、鍵盤翻譯與學習 Widget。支援 iPhone、iPad 與 Mac，免費下載體驗。
